WF-Diff.note: WF-Diff checkpoint unavailable; ran analytic fallback (wavelet colour correction), NOT the CVPR 2024 diffusion model. Scores are indicative only.

WaterMamba.scanner: official weights; the CUDA mamba_ssm selective-scan kernel cannot build on this host, so the scan runs through the chunked pure-PyTorch implementation in hydro_bench (selective_scan_chunked), which evaluates the same recurrence the authors' own selective_scan_ref checks the kernel against -- they agree to float associativity, asserted in the tests. Larger frames are reconstructed from overlapping cosine-windowed 256x256 tiles because the channel projections are sized to the released config's resolution.

metadata.mps_memory_pool: unbounded (PYTORCH_MPS_HIGH_WATERMARK_RATIO=0 at startup; oversized frames draw on unified memory)
metadata.rerun_note: UIEC^2-Net, Five A+ and WaterMamba were re-scored with their published models after that became possible (see run_rerun.sh); their columns and provenance entries here come from the re-run, every other value is the original run's. WaterMamba's earlier full-resolution scores were discarded: its tiled inference had an uncovered edge strip.

merge_note: Baselines copied unchanged from the original HydroBench run; PhysINR-Zero and each ablation variant ran in their own output directories and are merged here. See merge_provenance for the exact file behind every column.
